title: Settings — Media
description: Standalone Media-settings panel: image-size dimensions, thumbnail crop, and the year/month uploads-folder flag over the REST settings surface.

documentation.purpose: DataForm over the REST-exposed slice of WordPress's Media Settings: thumbnail / medium / large image dimensions (`thumbnail_size_w/h`, `medium_size_w/h`, `large_size_w/h`), the `thumbnail_crop` flag, and `uploads_use_yearmonth_folders`. Reads + writes through `core-data` `useEntityRecord('root','site')` via the shared `EntityDataForm`. The plugin's `register_setting` shims expose these eight options through `/wp/v2/settings` (they are non-REST in core). Composable host (`core:settings`) mounts this for the `media` panel; shells mount it directly as a Media screen.

interactions.effect: `edit({ <size>: int })` clamped to a non-negative integer (floor 0; 0 = do not generate this size).
`await save()`; success snackbar / error notice via `useEntitySave`.

a11y.focus-management: Native DataForm focus order is sufficient.

constraints.note: Dimensions clamp to a floor of 0 — a negative dimension is meaningless and the server schema floor would reject it.

`upload_path` / `upload_url_path` (custom upload location, shown only when non-default) and the multisite upload-quota panel are out of scope; this panel covers the eight common image-size + uploads-folder options.
